purpose: Checks allocation and confirmation/affirmation events against the 23:00 CET trade-date rule in Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1536 and the machine-readable-format mandate, refusing malformed timestamps and computing per-event pass/fail and batch on-time rate.
